user.title: APRS Position Sender
user.description: Beacon the position of a device tracker to the APRS-IS network.

data_description.callsign: Your amateur radio callsign including SSID, e.g. HB9XX-9.
data_description.passcode: Numeric APRS-IS passcode derived from your callsign.
data_description.entity_id: Device tracker whose latitude/longitude will be sent.
data_description.comment: Free text appended to the position report (max. 43 characters).
data_description.symbol_table: Single character: '/' for the primary or '\' for the alternate table.
data_description.symbol_code: Single character selecting the icon, e.g. '>' for a car.
data_description.min_distance_m: Send immediately when the tracker moved at least this far.
data_description.min_interval_s: Never send two reports closer together than this.
data_description.max_interval_s: Send the last known position at least this often, even without movement.
data_description.speed_unit: Unit of the tracker's 'speed' attribute. Home Assistant trackers such as the Companion app use m/s.

error.invalid_callsign: The callsign is not well-formed (e.g. HB9XX-9).
error.invalid_auth: The passcode does not match the callsign.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the APRS-IS server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This callsign is already configured for this device tracker.
